items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: I don't know that fella's name. ... Earl Williams. I don't know.

ctx.x: That's not Wiggins. Earl Wiggins is not the piano player.
I don't know that fella's name. Brownskins fella playing piano. Earl Williams. I don't know. He might be. He might be the right band. Kid Milton? That's not him.
